reason: I apply to enough internships that a tracker could help, but this sounds like another setup I have to maintain and configure. I would try a genuinely free self-hosted tool, but I wouldn't count myself as buying it when I still need to arrange hosting and provider credentials.
objection: Will this actually find enough relevant Indian internships, and can I trust its resume drafts not to make my projects sound bigger than they are?
would_change_my_mind: A quick demo showing solid internship coverage and project-based resume drafts that stick strictly to what I entered.
